main.description: Get administrative moderation state without retained raw content. A syntactically valid URI in a supported collection has state even when never indexed, using recordState unavailable and an initial version; malformed or unsupported subjects return InvalidSubject, never SubjectNotFound. Instance authority and actor identity come from the authenticated service context, never request fields.

parameters.description: Subject whose current moderation and repository state is requested

subject.description: AT-URI of the subject in a supported collection

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; authenticate with an authorized service account before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated actor lacks permission; do not retry unless its moderation authority changes.

errors.name: InvalidSubject
errors.description: The subject URI is malformed or uses an unsupported collection; correct it before retrying.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service is temporarily unavailable; retry later.

output.description: Current moderation and repository state without retained raw subject content

state.description: Authoritative current state for the requested subject
